ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms killed and valid mutant counts and the invalid-in-score flag are declared; it does not compute a score.
offer: Calculate mutation sensitivity from valid mutants and identify excluded outcomes. Invalid mutations must not inflate or depress the score through an unexplained denominator.

minimal.reason: Declare killed mutants, at least 8. A score from too few kills is noise, so record the count.

mid.reason: Declare valid mutants, at least 10. The denominator must exclude invalid mutants, so count only valid ones.

maximal.reason: Set including invalid mutants in the score to false. Invalid mutations distort the denominator, so exclude and report them.

rule.reason: Declare killed mutants, at least 8. A score from too few kills is noise, so record the count.
